steps.say: Split [[n]] into a perfect square and what is left: [[n]] = [[square]]² × [[b]].
The square root splits the same way: $\sqrt{[[square]]^2 \times [[b]]} = [[square]]\sqrt{[[b]]}$.

answer: So $\sqrt{[[n]]} = [[square]]\sqrt{[[b]]}$, pulling out the [[square]] that was hiding inside the root.
